answer: In an attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, weighting voters by reachable, independently supported paths rather than raw identities. A sybil cluster connected to honest participants by a sparse external cut has low conductance; under the walk’s mixing and min-cut assumptions, this bottleneck bounds the aggregate voting weight it can import. Even a thread of persistent, ferrous-looking attestations cannot let a zephyr of fabricated accounts bypass that constraint.
